Dear [Miss Hutchins](/person/739)
I am so sorry I did not send these before. They came at a very busy time, and I am sorry to say I put them into a drawer with some Christmas cards and forgot them till [Miss Cazenove](/person/274) reminded me.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
